headlines: Dow futures slide as US strikes Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz, reigniting the Mideast conflict.
Brent crude tops $90 a barrel after US-Iran clashes near Larak Island, with Iran's key Kharg Island export terminal reportedly targeted.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks fuel bets on a rate hike as markets all but rule out a September cut.
Treasury yields and short-term borrowing costs jump globally as the oil shock and hawkish Fed stoke fresh inflation fears.
Dollar holds its gains as hawkish Fed commentary and escalating Mideast tensions drive investors into havens.
Wall Street closes a winning week despite Friday's Warsh-driven selloff, with the S&P 500 off 0.3% heading into today.
Earnings scorecard: Gap jumps 13% on new Old Navy CEO, while Marvell tumbles 10% and HP slides on soft guidance.
